recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片兩格中細胞量豐富，箭頭標示多處異常細胞：分葉不足或雙葉核的顆粒球（pseudo-Pelger 樣）、核染色質異常團塊的細胞，以及紅系前驅細胞的異常，顯示不只一系出現發育異常。
features: Cellular aspirate with a mixture of erythroid precursors, maturing granulocytes and some larger immature cells
Arrows highlight hypolobated/bilobed granulocytes with clumped chromatin (pseudo-Pelger-like forms) and hypogranular cytoplasm
Arrowed cell with abnormal clumped, star-shaped nuclear chromatin (possible abnormal mitosis or karyorrhexis)
Erythroid precursors with some nuclear irregularity; megaloblastoid features cannot be confirmed at this resolution
Scattered larger cells with open chromatin (promyelocytes/myelocytes); no sheets of blasts
Resolution limits detailed grading of dysplasia in each arrowed cell
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (two fields) shows a cellular specimen with erythroid precursors, maturing granulocytes and scattered larger immature myeloid cells. Several dysplastic cells are indicated by arrows, including hypolobated or bilobed granulocytes with clumped chromatin and pale cytoplasm (pseudo-Pelger-like), and a cell with an abnormal clumped star-shaped nuclear configuration suggestive of an abnormal mitotic figure or karyorrhexis. Blasts are not increased in these fields, although a formal differential count is required. Findings are consistent with the stated diagnosis of myelodysplastic syndrome with multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no dysplasia in other lineages.
Shows giant metamyelocytes, hypersegmented neutrophils and megaloblastic erythroid precursors that correct with B12/folate.
Requires 5-19% marrow blasts by aspirate differential count, which is not evident in these fields.
Morphologically similar, so prior cytotoxic therapy, drug history and cytogenetics are needed to separate them.
